svg.title: How does text context meet audio to choose the next token?

g.aria-label: Audio encoder audio features Audio cross-attention & MLP
g.title: audio features

g.aria-label: Text token context current token sequence Token & position embeddings
g.title: current token sequence

g.aria-label: Choose the next token append token & repeat Text token context
g.title: append token & repeat

g.aria-label: Token & position embeddings text representation Causal self-attention
g.title: text representation

g.aria-label: Causal self-attention queries + residual Audio cross-attention & MLP
g.title: queries + residual

g.aria-label: Audio cross-attention & MLP repeat blocks, normalize Vocabulary logits
g.title: repeat blocks, normalize

g.aria-label: Vocabulary logits filtered scores Choose the next token
g.title: filtered scores

text.tspan: Convolutions + self-attention turn Mel input into audio features

g.title: Audio encoder Two convolutions with GELU (the second downsamples), positional encoding and self-attention/MLP residual blocks turn the Mel window into audio features.
Token & position embeddings The decoder embeds the current token sequence and adds learned positions. The cache determines the position offset when decoding incrementally.
Causal self-attention Each decoder block attends to the available text context using a causal mask and adds the residual result. Future token positions are masked.

Audio cross-attention & MLP Decoder queries attend to keys and values from encoder features. Cross-attention and MLP residuals update the text representation; these blocks repeat for each configured layer.
Vocabulary logits Final layer normalization and a projection using the token embedding matrix produce a score for each vocabulary token. Logit filters are applied before token selection.

Choose the next token The greedy decoder uses argmax at temperature zero and categorical sampling above zero. Append the selected token and repeat until end-of-text or the context limit; beam search is another supported decoder.

text.tspan: Task, language, optional prompt + generated tokens

g.title: Text token context Starts with task, language and optional prompt tokens. Each decoding step appends the selected token to this tensor, which is fed into the next decoder call until end-of-text or the context limit.
